episodes.synopsis: Bell's back with a new adventure! When the powerful leader of the Apollo Familia takes notice of him, his life with his Goddess is under threat.
episodes.title: Party | Banquet of the Gods

episodes.synopsis: Apollo Familia has laid down their challenge, but Hestia refuses. Apollo tries to force her hand...
episodes.title: Apollo | Sun God

episodes.synopsis: Bell goes to train for the War Game, and it's up to the rest of the party to rescue Lili. Hestia puts her plan into action, but Lili refuses to leave the Soma Familia.
episodes.title: Conversion | Gathering

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the War Games, and the Hestia Family, and its new members, are ready. Can they defeat the entire Apollo Familia and save Bell from Apollo's clutches?
episodes.title: War Game | War Game

episodes.synopsis: The Hestia Familia was victorious in their battle against Apollo, and now they've won a huge mansion and a giant pile of cash! Hestia sets out to recruit for the Familia, but there's something she's forgetting...
episodes.title: Home | The Hearthfire Mansion

episodes.synopsis: Bell is caught up in a new adventure that takes him to the seedy underbelly of Orario: the pleasure quarters.
episodes.title: Ishtar Familia | City of Lust

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Haruhime the Renard, Bell escapes from the Amazoness prostitutes. But he begins to wonder about Haruhime, who says she was forced to be a prostitute against her will and isn't worth being saved.
episodes.title: Renard | Fox Person

episodes.synopsis: Bell decides he's going to get money in the dungeon to purchase Haruhime. But he runs into a trap when the Ishtar Familia decides to kidnap him.
episodes.title: Ephemeral Dreams | Killing Stone

episodes.synopsis: With the true purpose of the ritual and the killing stone revealed, Bell decides that he's going to take any risk to save Haruhime.
episodes.title: Barbera | War Prostitutes

episodes.synopsis: The Ishtar Familia's plan has been found out by Freya, who launches a raid on their home. Just when things are bad enough for Bell, their interference brings even more chaos!
episodes.title: Argonaut | Longing to Be a Hero

episodes.synopsis: With Haruhime safe at the Familia, things begin to calm down. But when Hestia makes a casual pass at Bell and he shuts her down hard, she runs out of the mansion and into the waiting arms of kidnappers!
episodes.title: Rakia | Army's Advance

episodes.synopsis: Bell and Hestia spend a relaxing few days at a village in the wilderness, and participate in a local festival. Bell ponders what to do about his relationship with his immortal Goddess, and if he really is ready to love her.
episodes.title: Song of Love | Goddess and Child
